request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: integer answer (no options)

The charges q/2 and 2 q are placed at the centre of face and corner of a cube respectively. Total flux through the cube is (n q)/(2 ε_0) . The value of ' n ' is

result.working:
Charge q/2 at a face centre: it lies on the surface, so half of its flux goes into the cube, giving (1/2)(q/2)/ε0 = q/(4ε0).
Charge 2q at a corner: one-eighth of its flux goes into the cube, giving (1/8)(2q/ε0) = q/(4ε0).
Total flux = q/(4ε0) + q/(4ε0) = q/(2ε0) = nq/(2ε0), so n = 1.
result.note: The question is read as the flux through the cube's surface with the charges lying on that surface, as the usual solution assumes.
